path.description: glob (*, ?, [...]) of files to tail; one message per line

poll_every_ms.description: scan interval: glob rescan plus per-file poll

start_at.description: where a newly discovered file starts

on_eof.description: tail keeps polling for appended lines; stop finishes the source once every tracked file is read to its end (complete batch files)

close_inactive_ms.description: close a file's descriptor after this much idle time (0 = never); it reopens when the file changes

ignore_older_ms.description: skip files whose mtime is older than this when first discovered (0 = off)

clean_removed.description: drop the state of files that no longer match the glob once they are drained and closed

max_line_bytes.description: maximum line length in bytes (aligned with VictoriaLogs' default)

oversize.description: truncate emits the first max_line_bytes of an oversized line; skip drops it and counts

host.description: value for meta.host; defaults to os.Hostname()
